c74object.name: evi_resampling_templates.genexpr
c74object.digest:
evi_resampling_templates.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the "evieve" Package.
It is for using in a codebox or in another .genexpr file via the "require()" command.
By declaring require("evi_resampling_templates.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in the evi_resampling_templates.genexpr file.
The evi_resampling_templates.genexpr file also requires: evi_interp.genexpr
